Method of Attack: PHP object injection vulnerability via deserializing untrusted input allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP object
Exploitation requires presence of a Property Oriented Programming (POP) chain in another plugin or theme to execute code, retrieve sensitive data, delete files, or cause denial of service
Attack Vector: Exploitation of PHP object injection vulnerability CVE-2023-6933 in Better Search Replace plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Over 2,500 blocked attacks targeting CVE-2023-6933 reported by Wordfence in past 24 hours
